SimpleDataset#

class imbal.util.SimpleDataset(x_set, y_set, sample_weights=None, **kwargs)#

Bases: PyDataset

A simple extension of the tf.keras.utils.PyDataset class that allows for the storage of data, labels, and (optionally) weights.

get_data()#

Returns the data column of the dataset.

Returns:

A NumPy array containing all data samples.

get_labels()#

Returns the labels column of the dataset.

Returns:

A NumPy array containing all labels.

get_unzipped()#

Returns the data-label-weight tuples stored in the dataset in an unzipped format (i.e., this function returns the equivalent of (dataset.get_data(), dataset.get_labels(), dataset.get_weights()))

Returns:

A tuple of the form (data, labels, weights), or (data, labels) if sample_weights is None

get_weights()#

Returns the weights column of the dataset, or None if no weights are stored.

Returns:

A NumPy array containing all weights.

on_epoch_end()#

Method called at the end of every epoch.

set_weights(sample_weights)#

Sets the weights of the samples in the dataset.

Parameters:

sample_weights – A NumPy array of shape [num_samples, 1], specifying a sample weight for each sample in the dataset.

Returns:

None
